answer: Cheap clones swarm at dawn and vanish by the nadir of the reward window. Mechanism: every applicant posts a beacon bond of 3.1 POA that unlocks only after surviving a 54-hour cool-down while two unrelated attestors each seal a unique parent hash. Cost equals bond float plus 0.11 POA per missed seal hour. Peers verify by recomputing seal hashes before counting capacity. Failure: if either attestor flags a reused parent within cool-down, burn 42% of the bond and freeze admissions for that lineage one epoch.
